title: P3: Data-Path Decision (Q-S-001/001a/002a) — CLI vs Dolt SQL vs Hybrid
description: Third Planning round. Decide the canonical data-path Fizzy uses to read AND write Beads issues at runtime. Closes Q-S-001 (read), Q-S-001a (write), Q-S-002a (UUID-to-string FK migration cost). Inputs: P2 empirical proofs (both CLI and SQL paths verified working), llm/notes/dolt-rails-adapter-research.md (per-connection-branch caveat, multi-DB config pattern), llm/notes/community-bead-uis-research.md (hybrid CLI-write + SQL-read pattern proven in BeadBoard/Beadbox). Output: llm/notes/p3-data-path-decision.md with §A decision, §B evidence cited, §C trade-off analysis (8 axes), §D adapter shape sketch, §E migration implications, §F resolved Q-S items, §G open questions.
acceptance_criteria: File llm/notes/p3-data-path-decision.md complete with all 7 sections; cites P2 evidence + dolt-rails research + community-bead-UIs patterns; no vague AC; ratified 3-of-3 by [P3: agreed]. Cross-links Q-S-001/001a/002a to ANSWERED.

title: P2: Local Development Environment Grounding (bd+Dolt+Rails)
description: Second Planning round. Get a working local dev environment where bin/dev boots Fizzy AND Beads+Dolt is reachable from the Rails process. Critical research item per CEO Q7d. Output: skills/local-dev.md (canonical setup procedure), llm/notes/p2-local-dev-grounding.md (research findings + connection-pattern evidence). Empirical proof of at least one data-path option (CLI shell-out and/or Dolt SQL via Trilogy/Mysql2 adapter). This is the prerequisite for P3 (data-path decision answering Q-S-001).
acceptance_criteria: bin/dev boots Fizzy on http://app.fizzy.localhost:3006; Dolt server is up locally (verified via bd context); proof of CLI shell-out from Rails AND/OR Rails connecting to Dolt via Mysql2/Trilogy; skills/local-dev.md documents replicable setup; ratified 3-of-3 by [P2: agreed] signals.
